name: benchmark
notes: noise_std 0.005 ug/m^3 is about 3% of the reference-scenario peak concentration (see docs); sensors read every 600 s. Synthetic, idealised. alpha (Tikhonov strength) is null: it is read from design.alpha_selection_file, written by `configs/alpha_selection.json` on a separate VALIDATION ensemble (validation_seed 44). The test ensemble (test_seed 33, test_noise_seed 7000) is fresh: the earlier test seeds 22/5000 were seen while alpha was chosen and must not be reused.
